title: Time and schedule: read six essential words
description: Read everyday time, day, and week words in hiragana before practising meeting and appointment lessons.

review.provenance: Independently authored short time and schedule cues and explanations; common word spellings and meanings are linguistic facts, not legacy CSV or mock text.
review.rightsBasis: Original agent-written prompts, translations, contexts and explanations; no copied text, audio or third-party assets.

reviewItems.skill: Read 今日 (today) in daily updates
Read 今週 (this week) in sprint planning
Read 来週 (next week) in appointments
Read 毎日 (every day) in routines

exercises.prompt: In a daily standup message, read this word for the current day and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Share what you are working on today.

text.context: Share what you are working on today.

exercises.explanation: 今日 is read きょう and means today; note the contracted きょ followed by う to lengthen the o sound.

exercises.prompt: When telling a teammate your current status, read this word and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Say that you are checking a build right now.

text.context: Say that you are checking a build right now.

exercises.explanation: 今 is read いま and means now; it is used constantly before time expressions and ongoing status updates.

exercises.prompt: When checking whether someone has a moment to talk, read this noun and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Check the meeting time or duration.

text.context: Check the meeting time or duration.

exercises.explanation: 時間 is read じかん and means time or a duration in hours.

exercises.prompt: On a sprint board for the current week, read this time expression and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Confirm tasks planned for this week.

text.context: Confirm tasks planned for this week.

exercises.explanation: 今週 is read こんしゅう and means this week; しゅ is followed by う for the long u vowel.

exercises.prompt: When moving an appointment or review to the following week, read this word and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Schedule a room viewing or release for next week.

text.context: Schedule a room viewing or release for next week.

exercises.explanation: 来週 is read らいしゅう and means next week.

exercises.prompt: When describing a daily commute or standup routine, read this word and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Describe a routine that happens every day.

text.context: Describe a routine that happens every day.

exercises.explanation: 毎日 is read まいにち and means every day.
